title: Anatolia Unveils Organic Culinary Innovation Lab in Florence
excerpt: A state-of-the-art tasting lab and cold-press facility dedicated to certifying biodynamic olive oils and heritage vinegar casks.
content:
Anatolia Gourmet is thrilled to announce the opening of its flagship Culinary Innovation Lab in Florence, Italy. Engineered for sensory analysis and organic verification, the lab works directly with over 40 traditional Tuscan estate farmers.

Chefs and culinary connoisseurs can now request bespoke olive oil batch pressings and custom aged balsamic barrel selections with full blockchain traceability.

title: Paris Gourmet Expo 2026: The Harvest & Terroir Showcase
excerpt: Experience Anatolia's exclusive tasting pavilion featuring 36-month Jamón Ibérico de Bellota and wild Piedmont black truffles.
content: Join Anatolia Gourmet at the Paris Fine Foods Expo 2026. Our pavilion offers an immersive sensory journey through rare artisan cheeses, cold-extracted Tuscan oils, and Miyazaki A5 Wagyu paired by world-class sommeliers.

title: The Art of Cold-Pressing: Why First-Harvest EVOO Matters
excerpt: How low-temperature extraction within 4 hours of harvesting preserves polyphenol antioxidants and vivid herbaceous aromas.
content: Purity is paramount in every bottle of Anatolia EVOO. By maintaining cold pressing under 24°C and avoiding filtration chemical additives, we preserve the vibrant green color and high antioxidant concentration essential for gourmet cuisine.
